newsitem.title: USA: Executone sees Q2 loss $0.04 to $0.05/shr.
newsitem.headline: Executone sees Q2 loss $0.04 to $0.05/shr.

text.p: Executone Information Systems Inc said on Wednesday that, due to a major change in the purchasing patterns of its largest distributor, it expects to report lower revenues than expected for the second quarter, and a loss of $0.04 to $0.05 per share.
The company said in a news release that it currently expects to report revenues of between $40 million and $45 million for both the third and fourth quarters.

In previous quarters, Executone said, its largest distributor purchased large quantities at the end of a quarter to cover expected needs for the next quarter. Now, to keep its inventory in better balance, this distributor plans to purchase monthly product as needed.
This distributor, which Executone did not name, accounts for 45 percent of its total computer telephony related business and 20 percent of Executone's overall business.
The company said it would release complete results on July 24.
